title: Typeset
description: Long-form text as one cast part: eyebrow, headings, lead, body, lists, quotes and code on a single type scale.
usage: Wrap any article, doc or changelog body in .k-type and write plain semantic HTML inside — h1/h2/h3, p, ul, blockquote, code. Add .lead to the first paragraph and .eyebrow above the title. One wrapper, no per-element classes.
a11y: Keep a real heading order (one h1, h2 before h3) and let the text be the link text — 'read the migration guide', never 'click here'. The measure caps at 68ch so lines stay readable.
